# three-arm run measured as diverging from the HotSpot control.
#
# note: the JDK 21 serialization defect is FIXED (JDK 21 installs a run-time-generated GeneratedSerializationConstructorAccessorN, which the VM now delegates to instead of recognising only the JDK 25 DirectConstructorHandleAccessor), so the six JdkOnlyBreadthProbe serialization rows no longer diverge and the ratchet is re-tightened from 16 rows to 10. Accepted ONLY from a mint that captured the MAXIMAL set: the vthreads section is an intermittent race that showed 9 or 10 rows across a 4-run sweep on this host, and a baseline minted from a 9-row run reads the 10th row as NEW and sends the leg red at random. The remaining rows are the JavaLangAccess carrier defect and are NOT accepted behaviour.
#
# The gate fails when this set GROWS. A line that stops diverging is
# reported and passes, so a fix is never blocked by the gate that
# measured it — re-freeze afterwards to keep the ratchet tight.
